---
title: "MV_2025-12-16"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

datapath <- here("data","aggregated","MV_updated_aggregated.rds")
data <- readRDS(datapath)

```

```{r species richness}

richness <- data %>% group_by(survey_year,substrate) %>% 
  mutate(richness = length(unique(species)))
richness <- richness %>% select(c(survey_year,substrate,richness)) %>% 
  distinct(survey_year,substrate,richness) %>% mutate(grouping = case_when(
    grepl("Vegetation",substrate) ~ 1,
    substrate == "Air" ~ 2,
    substrate == "Bare ground" ~ 2,
    substrate == "Unknown" ~ 2,
    grepl("Water",substrate) ~ 3,
    substrate == "Mud" ~ 3,
    substrate == "Bridge" ~ 4,
    substrate == "Building" ~ 4,
    substrate == "Fence" ~ 4,
    substrate == "Other" ~ 4,
    grepl("Habitat",substrate) ~ 5))

colors <- palette.colors(16,"Alphabet")

richness1 <- ggplot(richness %>% filter(grouping == 1),
                    aes(x = survey_year,y = richness,group = substrate,
                                 color = substrate)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.85) + 
  theme_light() + labs(x = NULL,y = NULL,color = "Guild") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors[1:3]) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,8,1))

richness2 <- ggplot(richness %>% filter(grouping == 2),
                    aes(x = survey_year,y = richness,group = substrate,
                                 color = substrate)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.85) + 
  theme_light() + labs(x = NULL,y = NULL,color = "Guild") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors[4:6]) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,8,1))

richness3 <- ggplot(richness %>% filter(grouping == 3),
                    aes(x = survey_year,y = richness,group = substrate,
                                 color = substrate)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.85) + 
  theme_light() + labs(x = NULL,y = "Species Richness",color = "Guild") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors[7:9]) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,8,1))

richness4 <- ggplot(richness %>% filter(grouping == 4),
                    aes(x = survey_year,y = richness,group = substrate,
                                 color = substrate)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.85) + 
  theme_light() + labs(x = "Survey Year",y = "Species Richness",color = "Guild") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors[10:13]) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,8,1))

richness5 <- ggplot(richness %>% filter(grouping == 5),
                    aes(x = survey_year,y = richness,group = substrate,
                                 color = substrate)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.85) + 
  theme_light() + labs(x = "Survey Year",y = NULL,color = "Guild") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors[14:16]) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,8,1))

(richness1 + richness2) / (richness3 + richness4) / (richness5 + plot_spacer()) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Species Richness by Guild Collection per Survey Year",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))) + 
  plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect")

```
